audit.why: Favoured 4/10 matches the 54.02% win rate over 1929 games. Brand has no dash and no self-peel; Akali's threat is the shroud all-in from level 3 and the R execute from 6. Level chart is Akali all seven rows and is consistent with the win rate and packet chart.

Spikes read Lvl 3-5 (shroud trades), Lvl 6 (Perfect Execution, R 120/90/60), 1st item, Late. Brand's own spike is Blaze reaching three stacks — that is what turns Sear into a stun and Pillar of Flame into +25% damage — and it deserved to be named in the carry/feeding text.
audit.corrected: Grounded breakdown.carry and breakdown.feeding in the three-stack Blaze threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Conflagration (E) is Brand's only TARGETED spell ('conjures a blast at his target'), so Twilight Shroud's unselectable state denies it outright, while Pillar of Flame is cast at a target AREA and still damages her inside the smoke. Separately dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Sear — Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s.
audit.why: Riot's text: E targets a unit; W targets an area; W's derived 'terrain' flag is a tooltip-parse misfire — Pillar of Flame creates no wall and blocks no dash, so it never stops Akali's E-recast or R. Sear only stuns if the target is ablaze, so the gate is Blaze application (W/E), not Sear itself.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and enemyWin around: Blaze gates the stun; shroud denies targeted Conflagration but not zoned Pillar of Flame; real cooldowns 6s / 8s / 9s / 80s.

audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6. The punishable cooldowns are Pillar of Flame (10/9.5/9/8.5/8) and Pyroclasm (100/90/80).
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d.

audit.why: Whether Twilight Shroud's unselectability interrupts an in-flight Conflagration already cast on Akali, and whether Blaze's DoT reveals her in the smoke, are not answerable from Riot's text.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Twilight Shroud has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Brand Sear: 6s at rank 5, and it only stuns while Blaze is on you — dodge Pillar of Flame (8s) and Conflagration (9s) and the stun is just damage. - Twilight Shroud makes you unselectable, so Conflagration cannot be cast on you at all. - Pyroclasm is 80s: make him spend it on smoke.

edits.before: Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Conflagration is targeted — inside the shroud you are unselectable and he cannot cast it on you. Pillar of Flame is zoned and still burns the smoke; step out of it.

edits.before: Brand burns Sear (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: His stun needs Blaze first — with no ablaze stack on you, Sear is only damage.

edits.before: That’s Brand’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Ablaze, Sear stuns and Pillar of Flame hits 25% harder — walk out, not through.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze from 1050 range, stunning you with Sear once it is on you, then detonating the third stack.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Brand needs three Blaze stacks to matter; kill him before the third lands, shroud the answer, and E-reset out clean.

edits.before: If Brand opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sear (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Brand opens the score, never walk up ablaze — the Blaze burn alone chunks a Doran's. Farm at Q's 550 range, sidestep the Pillar, and stay relevant through shroud picks.

edits.before: Akali: at level 2 Akali's second ability adds mobility/poke Brand cannot answer without landing skillshots first.
edits.after: Akali: at level 2 the E flip closes 825 range inside Sear's 8-second cooldown, and Brand has no dash to reopen it.

notes: Brand's W 'terrain' derived flag is a tooltip-parse misfire — Pillar of Flame creates no wall and blocks no dash. Not asserted anywhere in the edits. Left breakdown.wave templated: nothing Brand-specific to ground it in beyond what breakdown.cooldowns already says.
